body: Trend lens: hindi ko pa tatawaging bagong policy trend ito; mas useful siyang recurring admin signal—targeted government mail + hard retroactivity cutoff = predictable window where procrastination has measurable cost. Ang dapat bantayan across future benefit programs: pareho bang pattern ng proactive notice pero claim-required pa rin? If yes, ALAM can treat official envelopes as deadline signals, not junk-mail furniture. Sa ngayon, isolated program rule muna, not grand theory.

claims.text: This benefit is better treated as a recurring administrative pattern candidate than evidence of a broader new policy trend.
claims.basis: The article establishes a targeted mailing and claim deadline, but does not establish repetition across multiple benefit programs.
